# Onis
Large, horned people that come in a variety of colors. Their accuracy with guns is terrible, but their physical strength brings them a lot of boons both in and out of combat.
## Benefits - They take [color=#1e90ff]15% less Blunt, Slash and Piercing damage[/color]. - They do more damage in melee: [color=#1e90ff]35% more Blunt and Asphyxiation, 20% more Slash and Piercing[/color]. - Clothing slows them down [color=#1e90ff]25% less[/color]. - Slightly more stamina than Humans, and [color=#1e90ff]25% more stamina damage[/color] with melee weapons that deal it. - They pry open doors in [color=#1e90ff]half the time[/color].
## Drawbacks - [color=#ffa500]Their accuracy with guns is terrible.[/color] - They are bigger than Humans, making them easier to hit.
